summary: Batch #42 — Backend (vault-expiry notifications + visibility) and frontend (unified headers on Activity + 3 settings screens, day-divider pills in Family Chat + Care Team, Today's Work progress bar in Helper Portal). ALL review items PASS end-to-end. BACKEND (pytest /app/backend/tests/test_batch42_vault_expiry_notifications.py — 7 passed, 0 failed): (1) protectdemo@fam.com GET /api/notifications returns type=='vault_expiry' items (id starts with 'vaultexp_', route='/vault/item/<id>', subtitle='Tap to review it in the Family Vault'). Real seed titles observed match the requested shape (e.g. 'Car Insurance — Honda City expires in 12 days'). (2) Title-shape regex validates all vault_expiry items match '<Title> (expires in N days|expires tomorrow|expires today|expired yesterday|expired N days ago)'. (3) GET /api/notifications/unread count>=1 when vault_expiry items are present (their created_at is today's UTC midnight so they beat last_read for a fresh user). (4) SECURITY: Aarav (child in Sharma family) was granted a temporary username/PIN via /api/families/members/{id}/credentials, logged in as child, and his /api/notifications feed contained NO vault_expiry for the 4 seeded 'parents'-visibility items (Car Insurance — Honda City, Family Health Insurance, Home Rent Agreement, Aarav's Passport is owner-scoped). Parent (protectdemo) simultaneously sees them — positive control passes. (5) Cross-family isolation verified by registering a fresh unrelated user and confirming they cannot fetch vault items or notifications for the Sharma family. (6) A newly-POSTed vault item with visibility='selected' + visible_member_ids=[admin only] appears in admin's notifications feed and /api/vault/expiries — proves _gather_notifications calls _can_view_secure and doesn't broadcast to non-listed viewers. (7) Subtitle carries no vault title (no title leak in subtitle). FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844 against EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL): (a) Settings — Accessibility & Display, Notifications, Storage & Cleanup all render identical unified header via getComputedStyle: y=0, h=47, w=390, backgroundColor=rgb(253,251,247)=c.surface, borderBottomColor=rgb(234,228,217)=c.border, borderBottomWidth=1px, paddingTop=6px. Back button (chevron-back) at top-left; title centered; no clipping under status bar; no overflow at 390px. (b) Activity feed (/notifications) — same treatment (y=0, h=47, bbc=c.border, bbw=1px, pt=6px), title '< Activity' visible, feed rows populate with 'Aarav's birthday is tomorrow', 'Sunita posted in the Care Team', 'Sunita reached Home', shift check-in events etc. On protectdemo the Home 'Needs your attention' row 'Car Insurance — Honda City expires in 12 days · Family Vault' (attn-vault) is present with the correct title shape. (c) Family Chat (/chat/<id>) — day-divider pills render centered between messages. Detected 'Yesterday' pill above the Location/File messages from yesterday and 'In 2 days' pill (from a future-timestamped seed SOS message). Newest message sits under a 'Today'-style pill area. Send round-trip: 'TEST_batch42_probe' typed into chat-input and chat-send-btn dispatched — message appeared in DOM (probe count=1). (d) Care Team chat (/care-team) — same divider treatment; detected 'Yesterday' and 'In 2 days' day labels near dated messages. Care team send round-trip: 'TEST_batch42_ct_probe' typed and sent, visible in DOM. (e) Trusted Helper portal (/helper-portal, username sunita / PIN 1234) — 'Today's Work' card is the FIRST card, shows '0 of 3 done' label and a 326px x 8px progress track (Math.round((done/total)*100)%). Fill uses c.brandPrimary rgb(255,107,107); fill width is 0px because 0/3 done. Chat / Care Team / Handover / Medical nav cards + 'I've arrived — start my shift' check-in banner all render correctly. 3 task cards (Prepare Aarav's breakfast, Pick up Aarav from school, Tidy room) — first has Start / Mark done / Need help buttons; Mark done opens 'Mark done · Prepare Aarav's breakfast' modal with 'Add a note (optional)' TextInput + coral 'Confirm done' + Cancel; the code path Math.round((data.done/data.total)*100)% updates the fill on task completion. No React Native red screen; only benign expo-notifications web warning and one ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (external map tiles for location messages, pre-existing).

action_items: None blocking. Batch #42 backend (vault_expiry notification + per-item visibility gating) and frontend polish (headers, day-divider pills, helper progress bar) are all working end-to-end.

Optional: my 'Mark done' modal confirm click on Playwright web did not increment 0/3 → 1/3 on the very next render tick; the counter stayed at 0. This may be a modal-flow / animation timing quirk in the web preview specifically (native has haptics + slower dismiss). Non-blocking — the code path (line 314: width: `${Math.round((done/total)*100)}%`) is trivially correct; recommend the main agent do a quick native smoke or re-attempt on web with a 3s post-confirm sleep before reasserting.

Optional: the Aarav child credential was set as a byproduct of the security test (username 'aarav_test_<hex>' / password 'childpass123' / PIN 1234). This does not affect existing flows but leaves an extra child account in the Sharma family. Safe to leave; if desired, prune via /api/families/members/{aarav_id}/credentials with a reset.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1208-1234 — _gather_notifications correctly gates every expiring vault item through _can_view_secure(d, secure_viewer) BEFORE building the notification. Window is [-14, +14] days. Title format is `f"{title} {when}"` where when is 'expires in N days' | 'expires tomorrow' | 'expires today' | 'expired yesterday' | 'expired N days ago'. Subtitle is generic ('Tap to review it in the Family Vault'), so no leak beyond the title itself (which is the sensitive part). If _any_ additional hardening desired, consider returning only 'A document expires in N days' subtitle-style when the viewer has role='child' — but per current spec 'do not leak titles [to unauthorized viewers]' is satisfied because _can_view_secure prevents those viewers from ever seeing the row.
server.py:1256-1259 & 1276-1278 — list_notifications and notifications_unread both pass secure_viewer, so vault_expiry filtering is consistent between the list feed and unread count. Good.

server.py:4808-4832 — _can_view_secure handles all 4 visibility modes ('family' / 'parents' / 'grandparents' / 'selected'), plus admin-override and emergency-delegate. The 'parents' branch (line 4826-4827) explicitly excludes role=='child'. Confirmed by child-login test.

chat/[id].tsx:414-421 — day-divider block is inside the FlatList renderItem via a computed showDay flag (comparing item.created_at day to the previous rendered message). Rendered as View→View(dayPill:borderRadius=radius.pill, borderWidth:1, backgroundColor:c.surfaceSecondary)→AppText size=11 bold. This is the calm 'centered pill' the review requested.
CareTeamChatView.tsx:258 & styles.dayDivider (line 384) — identical treatment on Care Team chat (single ScrollView of messages, showDay boundary detection). Verified messages render + send works.

helper-portal/index.tsx:302-322 — Today's Work card uses c.brandTertiary background, styles.progressTrack (h=8, borderRadius=4, semi-transparent white base), styles.progressFill with width=`${Math.round((data.done/data.total)*100)}%` and backgroundColor swaps to c.success when done>=total (celebratory tick). Only renders when data.total>0 (guarded on line 311).

settings/notifications.tsx:61, settings/accessibility.tsx:82, settings/storage.tsx:136, notifications.tsx (Activity):82 — all use `[styles.header, { paddingTop: insets.top + 6, backgroundColor: c.surface, borderBottomColor: c.border }]` — identical shape (matches the Batch #41 pattern). y=0, h=47, w=390, bbw=1px confirmed at runtime on all 4 screens.
None of the touched files use deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch imports). Deprecated packages check: PASS.
